chunks: My father (rah) said: Sa'd ibn Abdillah narrated to me from Ja'far ibn Muhammad ibn 'Ubayd-Allah from Abdillah ibn Maymun from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

Keep away from carelessness, for whoever is careless is careless about himself. And keep away from underestimating the command of Allah, the Mighty and Sublime, for whoever underestimates the command of Allah, Allah will disgrace him on the Day of Judgment.
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual consequence of being careless about Allah's commands?
ai.summary: In this hadith from Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Thawab al-Amal*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) links spiritual negligence (*ghafalah*) directly to self-harm, while warning that underestimating divine commands (*tahawun*) results in Allah humiliating the individual on the Day of Judgment. This reflects the Shia emphasis on *tawajjuh* (attentiveness) as a prerequisite for valid worship, where superficial compliance without reverence leads to spiritual diminishment.

en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 1. My father (rah) said: it was narrated to me by Sa’d b. Abdillah from Ja’far b. Muhammad b. ’Ubayd-Allah from Abdillah b. Maymun from Abi Abdillah (a.s.) who said: “

Keep away from carelessness because a careless person is careless about himself. Do not underestimate the command of Allah, the Mighty and Sublime because Allah will disgrace such persons on the Day of Judgment.”
